patch.value: The release workflow tags only after npm publish succeeds. Publish has failed fleet wide since 2026-08-21, so this package carries an untagged version and sits on the clock dependent path its own flag exists to remove.
This package generates its own changelog without the flag that stops the heading date coming from the clock

pm-changelog synthesises a pending release window for a version with no matching git tag and stamps it with the current UTC date. Its own changelog scripts and release workflow did not pass the date-from-version flag, the one this package itself ships for exactly that case, so its changelog check regenerates a different heading date every day and fails on any day after the changelog was written. Applied the flag to every invocation of the generator here: two sites in package.json and one in the release workflow.
Every invocation of the generator in this package passes the flag, and changelog check passes on a day other than the version's own calendar date

message: Apply the version-derived release date to pm-changelog's own generator invocations

value.note: the release workflow's generator invocation now derives the no-tag date from the calendar version
